thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD-78123 — KMS decrypt 429 spike (us-west-2) — page fired to #eng-oncall

pagerduty-bot: PD-78123 | Trigger: kms.decrypt.errors > 50/s (5m) | Impact: high error rate for decrypt API | Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-78123

emma (oncall): ack — I'm oncall. pinging infra + hsm. :rotating_light:

devin (infra): saw it too, just started ~12:32 UTC. lots of 429s and `KeyNotFound` in some logs, but mostly 429 TTL/queue. attaching sample:```2026-03-14T12:32:19Z ERROR decrypt: key=alias/app-prod msg="decrypt failed" err=429 throttle: request_queue_full```

maria (hsm): we're seeing HSM queue length spike, firmware-side reports `backend busy` during rotation handoff. suspect rotation job peeled open too many new key versions at once.

emma (oncall): do we know who kicked off rotation? @devin can you check rotation-runner jobs?

devin (infra): rotation-runner (scheduled) had a flapping retry loop after a deploy. job logs show it started a bulk rotate across 2k keys at 12:15 UTC. it didn't backoff. logs:```rotation-runner: started batch size=2000 target=prod keys processed=0->2000```

maria (hsm): HSM cluster can't accept that rate of new key material and the KMS layer is returning 429 to callers. also some `KeyNotFound` where alias points to a key id that hasn't finished provisioning.

emma (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) disable rotation-runner immediately 2) point alias back to previous primary key version for the most affected alias `alias/app-prod` 3) rate-limit rotation-runner config and add backoff 4) keep customers informed. I'll take 1 and 2 now.

devin (infra): good plan. how auditable is alias update? we can revert quickly.

emma (oncall): running update now — command:```# aws kms update-alias --alias-name alias/app-prod --target-key-id 1234abcd-previous```

emma (oncall): ✅ alias update returned OK. alias now points to previous key ID.

maria (hsm): confirmed from HSM telemetry — alias resolve no longer points to pending material. queue depth dropping.

devin (infra): disabled rotation-runner cron and scaled job to 0. command:```kubectl scale deployment rotation-runner -n infra --replicas=0```

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-78123 acknowledged by emma (oncall) at 1805123472

pagerduty-bot: PD-78123 escalated to HSM team (oncall) at 1805123500

devin (infra): metrics now: decrypt 429 rate fell from ~62/s -> 3/s in 3m. error budget not breached but customer facing errors observed.

product-ops: do we have an estimate of customer impact? region / product slices?

emma (oncall): preliminary: affected clients were those using rotation-enabled keys in us-west-2, primarily Dedicated customers with key rotation enabled. rough estimate: ~10-20% of decrypt requests failed during the 12:15–12:30 window; peak impact ~12:32–12:40. no data loss; failures are transient decrypt errors.

maria (hsm): HSM logs show throttling window ~12:15–12:34 while job hammered key provisioning. we hit a provisioning concurrency limit. after alias revert traffic normalized.

devin (infra): follow-ups: add rate limit to rotation-runner, add a guard that prevents concurrent rotation batches > 50 keys, and surface a deploy flag to disable rotations during deploys. also add alert for mass key provisioning spikes.

emma (oncall): tagging owners: follow-up owners = devin, maria, product-ops. we'll write a postmortem. for now I'll mark incident as mitigated but keep thread open for handoff. :white_check_mark:

emma (oncall): handoff to night oncall @nate (oncall-night) — please monitor until 06:00 PST and escalate if errors rise above 5/s for 5m. note: rotation-runner is disabled, alias for app-prod reverted.

nate (oncall-night): ack — I'm taking over. will watch dashboards and set PagerDuty monitor thresholds.

devin (infra): we've captured logs and rotation-runner job history and will attach to postmortem. also capturing HSM throttle metrics and KMS API traces.

product-ops: we'll prepare customer comms draft: explain transient decrypt errors during bulk rotation, mention no data loss, root cause = bulk rotation rate. proposed message: "We experienced transient decrypt failures for customers using automated key rotation due to a bulk rotation job that exceeded our provisioning limits. We reverted aliases and disabled the job. We're implementing rate limits and safer rollouts."

emma (oncall): good. leaving final comment before close: runbook gaps — rotation-runner should be able to pause on deploy, and KMS should expose a provisioning-concurrency metric to alert earlier.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-78123 resolved by emma (oncall) at 1805123899 — status: mitigated (monitoring)

nate (oncall-night): will keep an eye. if anything flares, I'll reopen PD. good handoff. :+1:

emma (oncall): thanks all. will schedule postmortem with owners and include timeline & remediation tasks.
